notes.title: Release announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thanks to the love, our independent game "Chinese Chess-Wargame" was released today. In the meantime, we're bringing a 15% launch discount.

Many people in the world are interested in Chinese Chess. Chinese Chess is a classic board game. It has many similarities with chess, but it is not exactly the same. This game is developed from Chinese Chess, which is very helpful for understanding Chinese Chess. At the same time, we have prepared a manual to help you understand the game.

The main changes in this game are the chess pieces, which greatly improve the flexibility of the chess pieces, and the difficulty is still within the acceptable range. You can find all the ways to play Chinese chess in this game, that is to say, this game is a superset of Chinese chess.

Currently, you can experience single-player games (without AI), local multiplayer or online multiplayer games in the game. There is a global leaderboard in the game, and the top three can get special titles!

The game is still in its infancy, so issues may arise. If you have any questions or suggestions, you can contact us through QQ group, Discord or email.

In the first three days of release, no points will be deducted for the online mode! However, the victory score is also reduced accordingly. The specific rules are as follows:

 All loser scores do not change
 The scores of both sides of the draw will not change
 If the level difference is less than or equal to 1, the winner will add 50 points
 If the level difference is 2 or 3, the winner will add 30 points
If the level difference is greater than 3, the winner will add 10 points


Looking forward to your play!

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
We have made the following updates:

Fixed the abnormality in the settings.
Fixed the display issue after entering the room.
Fixed some translation problems within the room.
Added prompts for preparing and leaving the room.
Fixed the issue where the game couldn't end properly in local play.
Added a countdown prompt; now the remaining time will be highlighted in red when there are 5 seconds left for a move.
Fixed the display problem in the leaderboard.
Fixed the issue with abnormal deduction of points when conceding.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3-Patch
notes.notes:
We have made the following updates:

Now, right-clicking in an empty area will deselect the selection.
Now, right-clicking on a chess piece will no longer allow it to capture another piece.

Additionally, we have updated the Chinese manual.
